persona: Dealer workshop diagnostic technician moving to an engineering diagnostics role
resumeText:
Imran Shaikh | Pune | imran.shaikh@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Diagnostic Technician, Deccan Motors (authorised dealer workshop), Pune (2019 - present)
- Diagnosed electrical faults on passenger cars using automotive wiring diagrams and diagnostic trouble codes.
- Read fault codes and live data with OBD-II scan tools and the OEM tester.
- Traced sensor and actuator faults with a multimeter and oscilloscope on the vehicle.
- Found the root cause of repeat no-start complaints and cut comebacks by a third.
- Explained repeat field issues to the manufacturer's regional service engineers on monthly calls.
- Handled hybrid vehicles under the workshop's high-voltage safety process.

Workshop Technician, Deccan Motors, Pune (2016 - 2019)
- Carried out periodic maintenance and electrical repairs.

SKILLS
OBD-II, CAN bus, Excel

EDUCATION
Diploma in Automobile Engineering, Government Polytechnic Pune, 2016
